title: How many spectral shapes does the VLA correction table for 3C 138 require?
abstract: We quantify the representation error of the VLA table of monthly scaling factors for 3C 138 from February 2021 through December 2024. Across 47 dates and eight bands, the smallest worst relative error achievable by a fixed band profile and free monthly amplitudes is 28.94%. Four table entries furnish the matching lower bound. For contiguous periods with independently fitted profiles, 24, 14, six and three profiles are necessary and sufficient at tolerances of 1%, 2%, 5% and 10%, respectively. We supply the dated partitions, numerical factors and independent optimization checks. The bounds apply to the published table rather than to the true flux density of a target.
